name: discord-server-manager-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Pages Functions, D1 and Cron Triggers deployment of the Discord Server Manager backend.

scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:site && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=discord-server-manager --branch=main
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply discord-server-manager --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply discord-server-manager --remote --config wrangler.toml
